description: Measure performance by metric. launch: startup time, cold, warm or hot, over repeats; trace: why. scroll: jank and frozen frames of a list (x,y or selector). heap: memory leaks, the heap to a file. frames: why frames were slow, hitches, hangs (what). cpu: top functions over seconds. snapshot: CPU, memory, frames, load and heat now (also). Returns numbers, findings, a trace's path; scenario keeps the run for compare_performance.

also.description: energy (says if a model); anonMemory: by process state, bitmaps; surface: a SurfaceView or game; startInfo: why it last started; battery: wake locks, wakeups, jobs

baselineProfile.description: Android, a release build: in the APK, applied, cold starts with and without

dsym.description: the build's .dSYM or a folder of them
